name: mcAI
description: Chat with an AI from the Minecraft chat bar via the '!ai' prefix, press H to send a screenshot to a multimodal model, and press G to analyse a build or redstone circuit. Local models (Ollama / LM Studio) need no API key. Includes multi-turn context kept in memory, cost estimation with an optional daily budget cap, multiple API keys with automatic failover, persona presets, sign/book translation, a world-context advisor, a local recipe helper that costs no tokens, death recap and Discord webhooks, streaming output, and fully localized UI text and API error messages (English / Chinese).
